CSE Script Processor

Owning Palette: CalcExpress Toolkit

VIs to execute scripts that involve loops, branches, and script calls.

 

Palette Object Description
CSE - Abort Script Execution.vi Aborts execution of the script associated with a specified CSE RefNum.
CSE - Close Instance.vi Closes the specified CSE instance context. If the context is dynamically created, the VI completely destroys it. If the context is static, the VI reinitializes it to reduce its memory footprint.
CSE - Execute Parsed Script.vi Executes a parsed CSE script.
CSE - Not A CSE RefNum.vi Validates CSE RefNum.
CSE - Open Callback VI Reference.vi Opens a VI reference to a CSE Callback VI, prepares it for execution, and saves its path for further use.
CSE - Parse Script.vi Parses a CSE script.
CSE - Script Path & Search Paths.vi Associates script file path and an array of search paths with the specified parsed script. CSE uses these paths if the script invokes another script using a relative file path.
CSE - Variables Writer ID.vi Use this VI to preset the writer ID used by the given CSE Instance for writing to variables during execution. The writer ID can also be modified using the vwrid(wrid) function in an expression/script.

 

Subpalette Description
